$comment: Settings for the ComfyUI sprite pipeline. Pre-filled from the models found
on this machine — check `checkpoint` and `lora` before your first run.
checkpoint: must match a file in ComfyUI/models/checkpoints exactly.
LoRAs are trained on SD1.5), sdXL_v10VAEFix.safetensors,
lora: null means no LoRA. You have no pixel-art LoRA installed yet.
Drop one in ComfyUI/models/loras and put its exact filename here — the
set will look far more cohesive with one. See SPRITES.md.
Everything else is fixed on purpose: the same sampler, steps and CFG for
all 20, so the only thing that varies between creatures is the prompt and
the seed. That is what makes reruns reproducible.
style_suffix: front view, chunky pixel art, bold black outline, flat cel shading, Game Boy Color palette, centered, solid magenta background
negative: text, watermark, signature, multiple creatures, realistic, 3d, blurry, gradient, drop shadow, extra limbs
$seed_overrides_comment: Per-creature seed override, e.g. "Flarepup": 12345. Anything absent uses the seed from creatures.json. Bump one of these when a single creature comes out badly, then rerun with --only <Name>.
